Estimated items before the meal:
- Enchilada/baked roll: about 120 g, roughly 250 kcal. Almost all was eaten, with only sauce residue left, so about 115 g and 240 kcal.
- Fried rice: about 250 g, roughly 350 kcal. About 40% was left, so about 150 g eaten and 210 kcal.
- Fruit: about 100 g, roughly 60 kcal. Mostly only the strawberry and melon pieces remain, so about 70 g eaten and 40 kcal.
- Salad: about 100 g, roughly 40 kcal, plus dressing of about 30 g and 60 kcal. About 60% of the salad was eaten, so about 60 g and 25 kcal. The dressing cup looks empty, so I counted the dressing as used, adding about 25 g and 60 kcal.
- Drink: a lemonade-type drink of about 250 g and 100 kcal. About 60% was drunk, so about 150 g and 60 kcal.

Totals:
- Mass: 115 + 150 + 70 + 60 + 25 + 150 = 570 g
- Energy: 240 + 210 + 40 + 25 + 60 + 60 = 635 kcal
